facts.fact: The NIA synopsis cites sections of the National Identification Authority Act, 2006 (Act 707), the National Identity Register Act, 2008 (Act 750) as amended and regulation 7 of the National Identity Register Regulations, 2012 (L.I. 2111) as amended as requiring the Ghana Card in all transactions where identification is required; no event date given, so published date 2018-05-29 is used.
facts.system: National Identification Authority Act, 2006 (Act 707) and National Identity Register Act, 2008 (Act 750)

note: The mandatory-use rule is undated here, so no applied fact.
